verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a human agent can step in inside the same platform when the AI concierge can't resolve a conversation, implying access to the conversation, but there is no explicit evidence of an automatic summary or structured 'collected details' handoff artifact accompanying escalation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an auto-generated conversation summary at escalation, evidence of structured collected-details/field handoff, and independent/hands-on confirmation that customers never have to repeat themselves.
